description: This source file contains the implementation of the AttributeGroup class within the OpenCart system, specifically for managing attribute groups in the catalog module, including methods for creating, editing, deleting, and fetching attribute group data.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Represents the attribute group model for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to attribute groups within the catalog module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Adds a new attribute group with descriptions for multiple languages, returning the new attribute group ID.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute group's data and descriptions based on provided attribute group ID.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Deletes an attribute group and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific attribute group by ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of attribute groups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute groups.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to an attribute group for a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with an attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for all attribute groups that match a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific attribute group across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for all attribute groups in a particular language.
